goal: Ask billing to remove a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill and get a reference number.

outcome.summary: The $30 charge was removed from the October bill and a reference number NS-18145 was provided.

lines.text: Your call is important to us.
The estimated wait time is less than one minute.
This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.
And the next available agent will be with you shortly.
Your call is important to us.
Thanks for holding. This is Maria in billing. How can I help you today?
Hi Maria, I’m calling on behalf of Alex Morgan. There’s a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill—could you please remove it and provide a reference number?
Absolutely. I can help with that. May I have the service address or the account phone number for
Morgan to look up the account?
The service address is 12 Oak Street, Springfield.
Thank you. I've located the account and removed the thirty dollars
charge from the October bill. A credit will appear on the next statement. Your reference number is n s one eight one four five. That's n as in Nancy, s as in Sam,
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you, just to confirm, the reference number is NS-18145. That’s all for today. Have a great day, goodbye.
